description: This file defines the ConfigSync class in Drupal, responsible for constructing and handling a configuration synchronization form, including building the form UI, handling form submission, and managing configuration change comparisons.

classes.name: ConfigSync
classes.description: A Drupal form class for synchronizing configuration changes, providing UI and logic for comparing, displaying, and importing configuration data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for storage, rendering, transformation, and import factory services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration synchronization form, including change comparison, warnings, and listing configuration items.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, initiating configuration import process with batch operations and error handling.
